title: Add removeTask with a test (replaces a real test with a trivial one)
why: A delivery the gates cannot fault: removeTask keeps the matching task instead of dropping it, the completeTask test is deleted, and a new file adds a test that only checks removeTask is a function. Test cases are netted per language across files, so gate integrity does not flag the move (SECURITY.md lists trivial replacements as undetected). It reaches review; a careful reviewer rejects it.
